# Template Compatibility Fixtures

These fixtures are minimized, offline, and source-classified for `SPRINT-006`.

- `skill-cases.json` covers MIT package README examples plus synthetic all-zero skill data.
- `equipment-cases.json` covers the MIT package README equipment example plus a synthetic
  single-item canonical export case.
- `pwnd-cases.json` records the evidence-backed paw-ned2 deferral. No public team codec is exported
  in this sprint.

The package examples come from `@buildwars/gw-templates@1.1.1`, which is MIT-licensed. Synthetic
cases were generated locally through the pinned public package entry point and contain no community
guide prose, screenshots, icons, tarballs, extracted dependency source, raw snapshots, or live
network output.
